end.summary:
Distinguished observation, hypothesis, law and theory in easy questions; a why or new-situation question is still needed.
Practised the scientific meaning of theory versus everyday meaning; some answers were right, but this was not steady yet.
Practised how evidence may support or overturn ideas; this is not steady yet.
Repeatedly said that theories become laws and that laws are higher; this was not corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Asha practised sorting observations, hypotheses, laws and theories, using examples and follow-up questions. Tara gave several right answers about law as a pattern and theory as an explanation, but the mix-up that theories become laws and laws are higher was still present at the end. At home, ask Tara to sort a few examples and explain why a theory does not upgrade into a law.
